one_line: Eunuch admiral of the Ming treasure fleets, leading diplomatic voyages between Nanjing and Calicut.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered, solid muscular build
appearance.face: Square face with strong jaw, broad forehead, warm medium complexion, heavy brows, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed thin mustache and short goatee, default expression calm and commanding with a faint reassuring half-smile
appearance.hair: Straight black hair pulled tightly into a topknot hidden under a tall dark-blue Ming official hat (wushamao-style, soft fabric, slightly flared wings), no loose strands
appearance.costume: Full-length Ming naval court robe in deep indigo-blue silk, wide sleeves, and a pale cream inner robe visible at collar and cuffs; front and back feature a square naval rank badge with a single stylized bird in muted gold and red; a wide dark-red silk belt with a carved wooden buckle sits at the waist, from which hangs a small pouch and knotwork tassel; lower robe reaches the ankles over straight dark-brown trousers, with simple black cloth boots; subtle cloud motifs woven tone-on-tone in the robe fabric evoke authority without flashiness.
appearance.signature: A rolled nautical chart of the Indian Ocean routes, bound with a red cord and tucked under his left arm, with the edge slightly unrolling to suggest detailed route markings.

ref_desc: Zheng He is a tall, broad-shouldered Ming admiral with a square-faced calm expression, black hair in a topknot under a dark-blue official hat, indigo naval robe with bird rank badge, red belt, black boots, and a rolled nautical chart in indigo, cream, red, black, and muted gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Zheng He: a tall, broad-shouldered Ming admiral in his early 40s with a square face, warm medium complexion, strong jaw, heavy brows, sharp dark eyes, and a calm commanding half-smile, wearing his straight black hair in a tight topknot hidden under a tall dark-blue Ming official hat with soft, slightly flared side wings. He is dressed in a full-length deep indigo-blue silk naval court robe with wide sleeves and subtle tone-on-tone cloud motifs, a pale cream inner robe showing at the collar and cuffs, and a square rank badge on the chest and back depicting a single stylized bird in muted gold and red. A wide dark-red silk belt with a carved wooden buckle encircles his waist, holding a small pouch and tassel, while the robe falls to his ankles over straight dark-brown trousers and simple black cloth boots. Under his left arm he carries a rolled nautical chart of the Indian Ocean routes bound with a red cord, slightly unrolling to reveal fine route markings. Use a palette dominated by indigo blue, cream, dark red, black, and muted gold, and show him from front, side, and back to clearly display hat, face, robe, belt, boots, and the chart.
